# Hands Of Grace Community Outreach

Hands Of Grace Community Outreach is a newly established faith-based nonprofit organization located in Manning, South Carolina, dedicated to serving community members in need with love, respect, and unwavering commitment to service. The organization provides practical support including food and clothing distribution, assistance with overdue utility bills, and medication help. While rooted in faith, the organization is not a ministry — faith-based support is offered only upon request, making it welcoming and inclusive to all. Led by a passionate team of four directors including Founder Ronald Collins, the organization embodies a warm, community-centered spirit focused on dignity and compassionate care.

## Meeting Practical Needs with Dignity & Respect


We believe that everyone deserves access to life's essentials, delivered with warmth and unwavering compassion. Our core services are designed to lift burdens and restore hope, one neighbor at a time.









### Food Assistance


Nutritious food packages and fresh produce distributed weekly to ensure no family in our community goes hungry.









### Clothing Support


Gently used and new clothing for all ages, distributed with care to preserve dignity and meet seasonal needs.









### Utility Help


Emergency assistance with overdue utility bills to keep the lights on and water running for families facing hardship.









### Medication Assistance


Critical support for prescription medications and healthcare access, ensuring health is never compromised by financial strain.








“Serving our neighbors with love, respect, and dedication — that's the heartbeat of Hands Of Grace.”

— The Hands Of Grace Team














## A new organization built on dependable local care.


Hands Of Grace Community Outreach was born in Manning, South Carolina, with a simple but powerful mission: to serve our neighbors with love, respect, and unwavering dedication. We believe that every person deserves access to food, clothing, and essential support — and we are committed to providing that care with dignity, every single day.






“We serve our community with love, respect, and dedication — because dignity is not a privilege, it is a right.”

— Hands Of Grace Leadership












### Based in Manning, SC


Serving Clarendon County from our home at 1173 James Martin Road, deeply rooted in the local community.








### Open Monday–Friday, 9–5


Reliable weekday hours so families can count on us when they need help the most.

Ronald Collins, Ernestine Frazier, Gwendolyn Walters, and Joe Frazier guide our mission with passion and integrity.

# Serving Neighbors with Dignity & Compassionate Care


Hands Of Grace Community Outreach provides practical, life-sustaining support to individuals and families in Manning, South Carolina. From food and clothing distribution to assistance with overdue utilities and medications, we meet urgent needs with love and respect. While our work is rooted in faith, we welcome everyone — faith-based support is offered only upon request, ensuring an inclusive, judgment-free space for all.
















### Practical Support, Delivered with Dignity


We believe that everyone deserves access to basic necessities without shame or stigma. Our team works directly with local families to provide food, clothing, and financial relief for overdue utility bills and essential medications — all in a welcoming, respectful environment.




### Inclusive Care, Faith by Request


As a nonprofit organization rooted in faith, we never impose spiritual guidance on those we serve. Our doors are open to everyone in the Manning community, regardless of background or belief. Faith-based support is available only when requested, ensuring our services remain inclusive and accessible to all.















Our Services

## How We Serve Our Community


We provide practical support with love, respect, and dedication. Every service is offered freely and without judgment — because everyone deserves a helping hand.











### Food Assistance


We provide nutritious food packages to individuals and families facing food insecurity. Our distribution includes fresh produce, pantry staples, and culturally familiar items that honor the dignity of every household.


Who may benefit: Anyone in Manning and surrounding areas experiencing food hardship — no questions asked, no proof of income required.










### Clothing Support


Our clothing closet offers gently used and new garments for all ages — from everyday wear to interview-ready attire. We believe clean, well-fitting clothing restores confidence and opens doors to opportunity.


Who may benefit: Families, job seekers, and individuals rebuilding after hardship. Seasonal items and children's clothing are regularly available.










### Utility Bill Assistance


We help with overdue utility bills to keep the lights on and water running. Our team works directly with local utility providers to apply payments efficiently, preventing service disconnection during difficult seasons.


Who may benefit: Households facing a temporary financial crisis, seniors on fixed incomes, and families with past-due notices.










### Medication Help


We provide emergency assistance for essential prescription medications. Whether it's a one-time need or ongoing support, we collaborate with local pharmacies to ensure no one goes without the medicine they depend on.


Who may benefit: Uninsured individuals, those between coverage, and anyone facing an unexpected medication expense they cannot afford.






All services are provided with dignity and respect. Faith-based support is available upon request — but never required.

Get In Touch

























"We serve with love, respect, and dedication — meeting every person exactly where they are. Faith-based encouragement is a gift we offer only when you ask for it, because belonging here doesn't require believing anything."





Hands Of Grace Community Outreach is a nonprofit rooted in Manning, South Carolina, providing food, clothing, utility assistance, and medication support to neighbors in need — no exceptions, no barriers, just compassionate community care.













## How to Reach Out for Support


We believe that asking for help should be simple, dignified, and free of barriers. Whether you need food, clothing, or help with a utility bill, our process is designed to welcome you with warmth and respect. Here is how our community outreach works.






1



### Reach Out


Contact us by phone at 803-225-3553 or visit our location at 1173 James Martin Road in Manning. A friendly team member will listen to your situation and guide you through the next steps. No complicated forms — just a conversation.





2



### Share the Need


Tell us what kind of assistance would help most — groceries, clothing, overdue utilities, or medication support. We keep your information confidential and treat every request with the dignity and compassion you deserve. Faith-based encouragement is available if you request it, but never required.





3



### Receive Support Guidance


After we understand your needs, we connect you with available resources — whether that is a food box, a clothing voucher, or direct assistance with a bill. Our team works hard to ensure you leave with practical help and the reassurance that you are not alone.









#### Need to speak with us directly?


Call 803-225-3553 during our office hours, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. If you reach us after hours, please leave a message and we will return your call as soon as possible.

Our Story

# Serving Manning withLove, Respect & Dedication











Hands Of Grace Community Outreach was born from a simple yet profound belief: that every person deserves to be treated with dignity, compassion, and unwavering respect. Founded in Manning, South Carolina, we are a newly established faith-based nonprofit organization dedicated to walking alongside our neighbors during their times of greatest need. Though our roots are fresh, our commitment runs deep — planted firmly in the rich soil of this community we are honored to serve.



Our work is practical and hands-on. We distribute food and clothing to families facing hardship, assist with overdue utility bills to keep lights on and homes warm, and help provide access to essential medications for those who cannot afford them. Every service we offer is delivered not as charity from a distance, but as an extension of family — with listening ears, open hearts, and a profound belief in the inherent worth of every individual who walks through our doors.







Rooted in faith, open to all. We are a faith-based organization, not a ministry — spiritual support is available only upon request, and everyone is welcomed exactly as they are.















## Our Mission & Values


Hands Of Grace Community Outreach provides practical, compassionate support to our neighbors in Manning, South Carolina. We believe in serving every person with dignity, offering help without barriers, and building a community where everyone feels seen, valued, and cared for — regardless of background or circumstance.









### Dignity


Every person who walks through our doors is treated with the honor they deserve. We see the whole person — not just their circumstances — and provide help that preserves self-worth and fosters hope.









### Respect


We honor the unique stories, backgrounds, and beliefs of everyone we serve. Our faith-based support is always offered by request — never imposed — ensuring a welcoming space for all.









### Compassionate Commitment


We show up consistently with food, clothing, utility assistance, and medication support — not as charity, but as neighbors caring for neighbors. Our dedication is unwavering because our community deserves nothing less.













## Our Leadership


Guided by faith, driven by compassion — meet the dedicated team serving the Manning community with love, respect, and unwavering commitment.











### Ronald Collins


Founder & Managing Director


Ronald Collins established Hands Of Grace Community Outreach with a vision to bridge gaps in the Manning community. With a heart for service and deep local roots, he oversees strategic direction, program development, and community partnerships. His leadership ensures every initiative is carried out with dignity, transparency, and genuine care for those in need. Ronald believes that a helping hand, offered with grace, can restore hope and strengthen the entire community.











### Ernestine Frazier


Director & Secretary


Ernestine Frazier is the organizational backbone of Hands Of Grace, managing records, correspondence, and compliance with meticulous attention. Her role as Secretary ensures the nonprofit operates with integrity and accountability. Beyond administrative duties, Ernestine is a compassionate listener who connects personally with community members seeking assistance, embodying the organization’s commitment to treating every person with respect and love.











### Gwendolyn Walters


Director & Treasurer


Gwendolyn Walters brings financial stewardship and transparency to Hands Of Grace Community Outreach. As Treasurer, she manages budgets, tracks donations, and ensures every dollar is maximized for community impact. Her prudent oversight allows the organization to assist with overdue utilities, medications, and essential supplies. Gwendolyn’s dedication reflects a deep belief that faithful stewardship is an act of service in itself.











### Joe Frazier


Director, Food Distribution


Joe Frazier leads the food and clothing distribution efforts with energy, organization, and a servant’s heart. He coordinates logistics, manages volunteer teams, and ensures families receive nutritious food and essential clothing with dignity. Joe’s hands-on approach and warm demeanor make every distribution day feel like a community gathering, reflecting the core mission of Hands Of Grace to serve with love and respect.

















## What You Can Expect from Hands Of Grace


We are dedicated to serving our community with love, respect, and unwavering commitment. Here's what that looks like for you and your neighbors in Manning.








### Rooted in Manning


We live and work right here in the community we serve. Our deep local presence means we understand the real needs of our neighbors — from food insecurity to keeping the lights on — and we respond with timely, compassionate care that makes a tangible difference close to home.







### Practical, Dignified Care


We provide food and clothing distribution, assistance with overdue utility bills, and help with essential medications. Every service is delivered with dignity and respect — you are not a case number here, you are a valued member of our community, and we meet you where you are without judgment.







### Welcoming & Inclusive Support


While our work is inspired by faith, we are not a ministry. Faith-based support is available only upon request. Our doors are open to everyone in need, regardless of background or belief. You will always find a warm welcome, a listening ear, and a team ready to walk alongside you on your journey forward.













Extending hands of hope and healing throughout Manning and beyond. Rooted in faith, growing in community.

- With your explicit consent

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 11, 2026



Hands Of Grace Community Outreach is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Hands Of Grace Community Outreach

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
